data.one_liner: An intuitive event-based system inspired by NodeJS's Event Emitter with type safety.
data.what_it_does: Provides an event-based system with type safety, allowing multiple data types for events. It supports both callbacks and streams through EventEmitter and StreamEventEmitter, and can be extended to create custom event emitters.
use_when: You want a NodeJS-style event emitter in Dart or Flutter
You need type-safe event handling where multiple data types share an event type
You want to use both callbacks and streams for managing events
avoid_when: You already use a state management solution that covers your event communication needs
You prefer built-in StreamControllers without external abstractions
strengths: Type-safe events allowing different data types on the same event type
Extensible classes to create custom event emitters and events
weaknesses: Can introduce event-driven architectural complexity if overused in a UI codebase
